clue.text: Promote fellow medic as tease

parts.note: to back a cause or candidate is to promote or support it
co- is the prefix meaning a fellow or partner, as in co-worker
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is the degree a medic holds

explanation.surface: Someone talks up a colleague in medicine, but only as a joke at their expense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tease' is not mockery here but the hairdressing sense: to comb hair towards the roots to give it volume.
explanation.definitionFit: Teasing hair means combing it against the grain toward the scalp to add body, the same act.

clue.text: Its rider may have us spellbound!

definitions.text: Its rider may have us spellbound!

parts.words: Its rider may have us spellbound!
parts.note: the rider is a witch, who casts spells and flies on this

explanation.surface: A horseman or performer so impressive the audience is enchanted.
explanation.definitionFit: A witch traditionally flies on a besom, and witches put people under spells.

clue.text: Church leader greeting character in Thessaloniki

indicators.note: the leader of the word Church is its first letter

parts.note: hi is an informal greeting

explanation.surface: An archbishop welcomes a figure in the Greek city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'character' means a letter of the alphabet; Thessaloniki is in Greece, so a Greek letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Chi is the twenty-second letter of the Greek alphabet, used in Greek cities.

clue.text: Stand for salt and pepper being put over fairly soft cake

indicators.note: being put over means the cruet is placed around the other letters

parts.note: a cruet is a stand holding condiments at table
mp, mezzo piano, is the musical marking for moderately soft

explanation.surface: The condiment holder is placed on top of a squidgy bun.
explanation.walkthrough: A crumpet is a soft, holey British griddle cake, eaten toasted with butter.
explanation.definitionFit: A crumpet is a flat griddle cake made from yeast batter.

clue.text: Fairground attraction lit up before unexpectedly good run

parts.note: lit up is slang for drunk, as is merry

indicators.note: unexpectedly means the letters of good run fall out in a surprising order

explanation.surface: Bright lights at the fair before a surprisingly fine winning streak.
explanation.definitionFit: A carousel of revolving horses is a classic ride at a funfair.

clue.text: Start of sentence in 9 briefly entertaining old player

indicators.note: entertaining means holding a guest within, so the letter for old goes inside
in means the initial of sentence goes inside the short notice

parts.note: 9 across is OBITUARY, and its short form is obit

indicators.note: the start of the word sentence is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A line from a death notice somehow includes a veteran musician.
explanation.walkthrough: S goes into OBIT to make OBIST, which then takes in O after the B.
explanation.definitionFit: An oboe player is a musician, so the general word player covers this woodwind performer.

clue.text: Painter, composer and inventor in one

parts.note: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Several artists and an engineer rolled into one person.
explanation.walkthrough: Giovanni Bellini was a Venetian painter; Vincenzo Bellini an Italian opera composer.
explanation.definitionFit: The surname belongs to both a Renaissance painting family and the composer of Norma.

clue.text: Old Peruvian film director's extremely overblown charm

parts.note: Incan describes the people of the old Peruvian empire
Jacques Tati was a French film director

indicators.note: extremely picks the very outermost letters of the word overblown

explanation.surface: An ancient Andean's movie-maker has an exaggerated appeal.
explanation.definitionFit: A charm is a spell or magic formula chanted aloud, the same as an incantation.

clue.text: Well-groomed and generous

definitions.meaning: as in a sizeable sum of money, a large amount

explanation.definitionFit: Neat means orderly in appearance, and a sizeable sum in British slang is a handsome one.

clue.text: Notice one gets for being late?

definitions.text: Notice one gets for being late?

parts.words: Notice one gets for being late?
parts.note: late here means dead, not tardy; the newspaper notice marks a death

explanation.surface: A warning slip handed to someone who turned up after time.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper notice of someone's death, often with a short life story, is printed for the departed.

clue.text: Composed opening for ceilidh, wearing tartan cloth

indicators.note: wearing means the cloth goes around the letter like a garment

parts.note: a plaid is a length of tartan woollen cloth worn in Scotland

indicators.note: the opening of the word ceilidh is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone stays calm at the start of a Scottish dance, dressed in tartan.
explanation.walkthrough: A ceilidh is a Scottish or Irish evening of folk music and dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: Composed and calm are synonyms describing someone serene and unflustered.

clue.text: Very proper to take a short time getting up to New York — good motorway to it

annotationWithheld.why: Very proper to take a short time getting up to New York — good motorway to it (6-6): the wordplay (rev MIN + I + NY) builds NIMINY-PIMINY, not the held MIMINYPIMINY, and 'to it' gives NY a second time, reusing New York.
annotationWithheld.clue: Very proper to take a short time getting up to New York — good motorway to it

clue.text: Kant, for one, ran into someone like Edward Jenner

parts.note: to have met someone is to have run into them
Jenner, pioneer of smallpox vaccination, was a doctor, so someone like him is a doctor of medicine

explanation.surface: The German philosopher bumped into the famous vaccine pioneer.
explanation.definitionFit: Immanuel Kant wrote on the nature of being and knowledge, the field of a metaphysics scholar.

clue.text: Cut lanterns out, letting some light through

indicators.note: out means the letters of cut lanterns are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: Holes are cut in lamps so a glow shines through.
explanation.definitionFit: A material that lets light pass but diffuses it is semi-transparent.

clue.text: One coming from Campania to an Alpine resort

indicators.note: read as re-sort, meaning sort the letters again

explanation.surface: An Italian from Naples travels to a ski town in the mountains.
explanation.walkthrough: Campania is the region of southern Italy whose capital is Naples.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone born in Naples, the capital of Campania, bears this demonym.

clue.text: Part of body found after search, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word for found sounds like the entry

parts.note: something tracked has been followed and found after a hunt

explanation.surface: A body part is discovered after a hunt.
explanation.definitionFit: The digestive or respiratory tract is a system of organs, a part of the body.

clue.text: From kick off, with grin I foul, breaking a toe nastily

indicators.note: breaking means the jumbled grin I splits the other set of letters apart
nastily means the letters of a toe are twisted out of shape
foul means the letters of grin and I are fouled up into a new order

explanation.surface: A footballer grins while fouling at kick-off and hurts an opponent's toe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foul' makes RIGIN from GRIN I; 'nastily' makes OATE from A TOE; 'breaking' puts RIGIN after the O. 'From' is a link: from the wordplay comes a word meaning kick off.
explanation.definitionFit: To start or begin something is to set it going, a sense shared by kicking off.

clue.text: Officer's dreadfully gloomy scientific study

parts.note: CO, commanding officer, with the possessive giving CO's

indicators.note: dreadfully means the letters of gloomy are badly rearranged

explanation.surface: A commanding officer's research turns out to be very depressing.
explanation.definitionFit: The science of the origin and structure of the universe is a branch of astronomy and physics.

clue.text: Location of fruit and fish skirted by ring road

parts.note: O is ring-shaped

indicators.note: skirted by means the fish is surrounded by the ring and road letters

parts.note: char is a fish of the trout family

explanation.surface: Where apples and a trout sit, edged by a circular route.
explanation.definitionFit: A plot of fruit trees grown together is where apples and plums are found.

clue.text: Briefly ape 2's political representative

parts.note: 2 down's answer is the Greek letter chi
MP, Member of Parliament, is an elected political representative

explanation.surface: A short impression of the Greek letter's member of parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: The short form of chimpanzee names an ape, so briefly marks the clipped word.

clue.text: About turn involving this classical city?

indicators.note: involving means the abbreviation for about wraps around the Latin word

parts.note: ca, circa, means about
hic is Latin, the classical language, for this
a go is a turn in a game

explanation.surface: Turning around takes us to an ancient city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About turn' looks like the military command, but splits into About and turn.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicago is a major city in Illinois, United States.

clue.text: Not qualified in one foreign state, and another in America

parts.note: un is French for one
a state of affairs is a condition
AL is Alabama, another state, this time in the USA

explanation.surface: Someone is unqualified in one overseas nation and another in the US.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state' does double duty in the surface, but in the wordplay 'another' points to a second state, Alabama.
explanation.definitionFit: An offer with no qualifications or conditions attached is absolute, without reservation.

clue.text: Driver possibly in a suit?

parts.note: a driver is one kind of golf stick; also one of the four card suits

explanation.surface: A chauffeur wearing smart business clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A golf driver is a wood used for long shots, and clubs is a card suit.

clue.text: Play song, receiving little in return

indicators.note: receiving means the song takes the other letters inside it

parts.note: a lay is an old word for a song or ballad

indicators.note: in return means the word for little is read backwards

parts.note: wee is Scottish for little

explanation.surface: A musician performs a song and gets a small fee back.
explanation.definitionFit: Play in the sense of room to move, slack or margin of freedom.

clue.text: So far unbeaten competitor (female) on a roll?

parts.note: on a list means in it, so on gives in
a roll is a register or list of names

explanation.surface: A winning sportswoman is on a lucky streak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On a roll' means on a winning run, but here it is read as IN A LIST, being named on a register.
explanation.definitionFit: A contestant who reaches the final round has not yet been knocked out.

clue.text: Fury when leader of republic is removed

indicators.note: leader of points to the first letter of the republic's name
is removed means that first letter is dropped

parts.note: Eire is the Irish name of the Republic of Ireland

explanation.surface: Anger when the head of state is deposed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ire is a literary synonym for anger or wrath.

clue.text: Happen to stay around the centre of Exeter

indicators.note: around means the word for stay is wrapped about the middle letters

parts.note: to bide is to stay or wait

indicators.note: the centre of the six-letter Exeter is its middle pair

explanation.surface: Something occurs to a visitor staying near the middle of a Devon city.
explanation.walkthrough: Exeter is a cathedral city in Devon, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic verb meaning to befall someone, as in woe betide you.

clue.text: Novice of slender build, a native of Innsbruck?

parts.note: a tyro is a beginner or novice
lean means thin, of slight build

explanation.surface: A thin beginner from the Austrian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Innsbruck is the capital of the Austrian Tyrol, so someone born there is from that region.
